fields.name: sequence
fields.label: Position
fields.description: When several layouts fit a person, the one with the smallest number is used.

fields.name: roles
fields.label: Roles
fields.description: One role per line. People with any of these roles get this layout. Leave empty for everyone.

fields.name: hidden_fields
fields.label: Hidden fields
fields.description: One field name per line. These fields are not shown on the form for these people. A required field cannot be hidden.
